subject: Coordinating package releases for ggplot2 v0.92

messages.author: a79eb65f0eae8655
messages.subject: Coordinating package releases for ggplot2 v0.92
parts:
Winston (and everyone),

What's the word on whether/how we can coordinate our package releases for ggplot2 0.92? I believe when ggplot2 v0.90 was released, the CRAN maintainers allowed us to submit updated versions of our packages that were kept in a virtual "holding pen," then released concurrently with 0.90 so dependencies wouldn't be broken.

I ask because for my package—and I suspect others are in this boat—I updated it to exclusively use the new theme system. If I release today, its dependencies can't be satisfied. But, if the CRAN maintainers are willing to do a similar "holding pen" thing, I can send my package to them now and be sure that when 0.92 is released, my new version will also be released.

- B
